blocks.text: Ingliz tilida ikkita artikl bor. **a / an** — **noaniq** artikl: tinglovchi aynan qaysi narsa haqida gap ketayotganini bilmaydi yoki bu muhim emas. **the** — **aniq** artikl: gapiruvchi ham, tinglovchi ham qaysi biri ekanini biladi. I've got **a** car — mashinam bor (yangi xabar). **The** car is in the garage — mashina (o'sha, biz biladigan) garajda. O'zbekchada artikl yo'q, lekin «aniq — noaniq» farqi boshqa vositalar bilan baribir ifodalanadi. Ularni bilsangiz, inglizcha artiklni tanlash ancha osonlashadi.

Eng foydali o'xshashlik — tushum kelishigi `-ni`. «Kitob o'qidim» — qandaydir kitob (**a** book), «Kitobni o'qidim» — ikkalamiz biladigan kitob (**the** book). So'z tartibi ham yordam beradi: «Stolda kitob bor» — yangi narsa, oxirida (**a**); «Kitob stolda» — ma'lum narsa, boshida (**the**). Lekin bular faqat yo'l-yo'riq: `-ni` faqat to'ldiruvchida bor, «haligi» esa har doim aytilavermaydi. Inglizchada esa artikl har bir ot oldida tanlanadi — shuning uchun asosiy savolni yodda tuting: **tinglovchi qaysi biri ekanini biladimi?**

Hikoya qilganda yangi odam yoki narsa birinchi marta **a / an** bilan kiritiladi: tinglovchi u haqida hali hech narsa bilmaydi. Keyingi safar esa u endi «tanish» — **the** bilan aytiladi. O'zbekchada xuddi shu joyda «bir» va «haligi / u» almashinadi: «Bir it va bir mushuk ko'rdim. It qora edi.»

items.text: I saw **a dog** and **a cat** in the yard.
**The dog** was black, and **the cat** was white.

blocks.text: Qaysi biri ekani aniq bo'lsa — the

**the** uchun narsa oldin tilga olingan bo'lishi shart emas. Vaziyatdan qaysi biri ekani aniq bo'lsa — **the**. Uyda: **the** kitchen, **the** door, **the** fridge (uyda bittadan, hamma qaysi ekanini biladi). Xonada: Close **the** window (shu xonadagi deraza). Shaharda: **the** station, **the** airport, **the** city centre (shaharda bittadan yoki doim boradigan joy). O'zbekchada bu yerda hech qanday belgi bo'lmasligi mumkin: «Derazani yop» — Close **the** window.

rows: Is there **a** bank near here? (biror bank)
I'm going to **the** bank. (men doim boradigan bank)
The children are in **the** garden. (uyimizdagi bog')
Can you close **the** window? (anavi ochiq deraza)

blocks.text: Yagona narsa: the capital, the president

Agar biror narsa vaziyatda yoki dunyoda **bitta** bo'lsa, u doim **the** bilan: **the** capital of Uzbekistan (poytaxt bitta), **the** President, **the** floor, **the** ceiling, **the** end of the film. Sababi oddiy: bitta bo'lgan narsada «qaysi biri?» degan savol tug'ilmaydi. Dunyoda yagona narsalar — **the** sun, **the** moon, **the** sky — 70-darsda batafsil.
the + ot + aniqlovchi: the man in the black coat

Ot keyidagi so'zlar uni aniqlab bersa — **the**: **the** capital **of** France, **the** man **in** the black coat, **the** book **on** the table, **the** bus **to** the airport. Bu so'zlar «qaysi biri?» degan savolga javob beradi. Taqqoslang: **a** room **in** a hotel (mehmonxonadagi biror xona) — **the** room **on** the third floor (uchinchi qavatdagi o'sha xona).
the — ko'plik va sanalmaydigan ot bilan ham

**a / an** faqat birlikdagi sanaladigan ot bilan ishlaydi, **the** esa hamma turdagi ot bilan: **the** key, **the** keys, **the** salt. Noaniq ko'plik va sanalmaydigan ot oldida artikl yo'q yoki **some** turadi: We bought **some** apples — **The** apples were sweet. Pass **the** salt, please — stoldagi o'sha tuz.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: artiklni umuman tashlab ketish («I saw dog in street» → **I saw a dog in the street**); birinchi marta tilga olingan narsaga **the** («Yesterday I bought the new phone» → **a new phone**); uydagi tanish narsaga **a** («Where is a kitchen?» → **Where's the kitchen?**); «bir» ni **one** deb tarjima qilish («One man asked me» → **A man asked me**).

O'zingizga bitta savol bering: «Tinglovchi qaysi biri ekanini biladimi?» Ha (oldin aytilgan, vaziyatdan aniq yoki bitta) → **the**. Yo'q (yangi, har qanday, ko'pdan biri) → **a / an**. O'zbekchada «haligi», «o'sha» yoki `-ni` qo'yish mumkin bo'lsa — ko'pincha **the**.

Artikllar mavzusining davomi: **the** sun, **the** same, play **the** piano — 70-dars; go to work, at home (artiklsiz iboralar) — 71-dars; I like music (umumiy ma'no, artiklsiz) — 72-dars; joy nomlari bilan **the** — 73-dars.

rows: birinchi marta tilga olingan: I saw **a** dog.
qaysidir biri, har qanday: Is there **a** bank here?
aynan shu, ma'lum: I'm going to **the** bank.
ko'pdan biri: a room in **a** hotel
yagona yoki aniqlangan: **the** capital of France
har qanday ot: **the** key / keys / salt

examples.title: First **a**, then **the**: telling a story
examples.description: Yangi narsa birinchi marta **a / an** bilan kiritiladi, keyin u tanish — **the**. O'zbekchada «bir» va «haligi» kabi.

sentences.text: We've got **a cat** and **a dog**. **The cat** is older.
I bought **a shirt** and **a jacket**, but **the jacket** was too small.
sentences.translation: **Ko'ylak** va **kurtka** sotib oldim, lekin **kurtka** kichik chiqdi.

sentences.text: There's **a new café** on our street. **The coffee** there is excellent.
sentences.translation: Ko'chamizda **yangi kafe** ochildi. U yerdagi **qahva** a'lo.

sentences.text: Aziz watched **a film** last night, but he didn't like **the ending**.
sentences.translation: Aziz kecha **film** ko'rdi, lekin **filmning oxiri** unga yoqmadi.

sentences.text: Yesterday **a man** and **a woman** came into the shop. **The man** bought flowers.
sentences.translation: Kecha do'konga **bir erkak** va **bir ayol** kirdi. **Erkak** gul sotib oldi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza ordered **a pizza** and **a salad**, but **the pizza** arrived cold.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza **pitsa** va **salat** buyurtma qildi, lekin **pitsa** sovuq keldi.

sentences.text: Tom lives in **an old house**. **The house** has got a beautiful garden.
sentences.translation: Tom **eski uyda** yashaydi. **Uyning** chiroyli bog'i bor.

sentences.text: I had **an interview** on Monday, and **the interview** went really well.
sentences.translation: Dushanba kuni **suhbatga** bordim, **suhbat** juda yaxshi o'tdi.

sentences.text: My grandfather told me a story about **a poor farmer** and **a rich man**. In the end **the farmer** became rich too.
sentences.translation: Bobom menga **kambag'al dehqon** va **boy odam** haqida ertak aytib berdi. Oxirida **dehqon** ham boyib ketdi.

sentences.text: Madina found **a wallet** with **a photo** in it. **The photo** showed a young couple in Samarkand.
sentences.translation: Madina ichida **surat** bor **hamyon** topib oldi. **Suratda** Samarqanddagi yosh juftlik bor edi.

examples.title: At home: **the** kitchen, **the** door
examples.description: Uyda hamma qaysi narsa ekanini biladi — **the**: the kitchen, the window, the fridge, the cat. Oldin tilga olinmagan bo'lsa ham. O'zbekchada ko'pincha `-ni` bilan: «Derazani yop».

sentences.text: Can you close **the window**? It's cold.
**The kettle** is in **the kitchen**, next to **the fridge**.
Where's **the remote control**? I want to watch the news.
Don't forget to turn off **the lights** before you go to bed.
Somebody is at **the door** — can you open it?
Dad is in **the garden**, and Mum is cooking dinner.
sentences.translation: Dadam **bog'da**, oyim esa kechki ovqat pishiryapti.

sentences.text: Please feed **the cat** before you leave.
sentences.translation: Ketishdan oldin **mushukka** ovqat berib ket, iltimos.

sentences.text: Who's in **the bathroom**? I've been waiting for ten minutes!
sentences.translation: **Hammomda** kim bor? O'n daqiqadan beri kutyapman!

sentences.text: **The washing machine** isn't working again — we need **a repairman**.
sentences.translation: **Kir yuvish mashinasi** yana ishlamayapti — bizga **usta** kerak.

sentences.text: Bekzod, can you take **the rubbish** out? **The bin** in **the kitchen** is full.
sentences.translation: Bekzod, **axlatni** chiqarib tashlay olasanmi? **Oshxonadagi chelak** to'lib qolibdi.

examples.title: In town: **the** station, **the** city centre
examples.description: Shaharda bittadan bo'lgan yoki hamma biladigan joylar — **the**: the station, the airport, the city centre, the market, the post office, the metro.

sentences.text: Excuse me, how far is it to **the station** from here?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bu yerdan **vokzalgacha** qancha masofa bor?

sentences.text: Let's meet in **the city centre** at six.
**The airport** in Tashkent is quite close to the city.
Mum is at **the market** — she'll be back soon.
Is **the post office** open on Saturdays?
Excuse me, which bus goes to **the university**?
I have to go to **the bank** today to pay my bills.
sentences.translation: Bugun to'lovlarni to'lash uchun **bankka** borishim kerak.

sentences.text: There's always a lot of traffic near **the stadium** when there's a match.
sentences.translation: O'yin bo'lganda **stadion** atrofida doim tirbandlik bo'ladi.

sentences.text: James took a taxi from **the hotel** to **the museum**, and it cost twenty pounds.
sentences.translation: Jeyms **mehmonxonadan** **muzeygacha** taksida bordi, yigirma funt to'ladi.

sentences.text: When you come out of **the metro**, turn left and you'll see **the theatre**.

examples.title: **a** = any one, **the** = that one
examples.description: Bir gapda ikkalasi: **a** — har qanday, qaysidir biri; **the** — aynan shu, ma'lum. Is there **a** bank? — Yes, **the** bank is opposite the mosque.

sentences.text: Is there **a bank** near here? — Yes, **the bank** is opposite the mosque.
sentences.translation: Bu yerga yaqin **bank** bormi? — Ha, **bank** masjidning ro'parasida.

sentences.text: I need **a doctor**! — Don't worry, **the doctor** is coming.
We haven't got **a garage**, so **the car** stays in the street.
sentences.translation: Bizda **garaj** yo'q, shuning uchun **mashina** ko'chada turadi.

sentences.text: Can I borrow **a pen**? — Sure, **the pens** are in that box.
sentences.translation: **Ruchka** olib tursam bo'ladimi? — Albatta, **ruchkalar** anavi qutida.

sentences.text: Sarah wants to buy **a flat**, but **the flats** in the centre are expensive.
sentences.translation: Sara **kvartira** sotib olmoqchi, lekin markazdagi **kvartiralar** qimmat.

sentences.text: Did you watch **a film** last night? — No, I watched **the match** between Pakhtakor and Navbahor.
sentences.translation: Kecha **film** ko'rdingmi? — Yo'q, Paxtakor va Navbahor o'rtasidagi **o'yinni** ko'rdim.

sentences.text: Bekzod is **a teacher** at **the school** near our house.
There's **a problem** with **the computer** in my office.
Aziz called **a taxi**, but **the taxi** didn't come for forty minutes.
sentences.translation: Aziz **taksi** chaqirdi, lekin **taksi** qirq daqiqagacha kelmadi.

sentences.text: My parents stayed in **a small hotel** in Khiva, and **the owner** cooked breakfast for them every morning.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam Xivadagi **kichkina mehmonxonada** to'xtashdi, **mehmonxona egasi** ularga har kuni ertalab nonushta tayyorlab berardi.

examples.title: **the** + noun + of / in: the capital of ...
examples.description: Ot keyidagi so'zlar uni aniqlab bersa — **the**: the capital **of** Uzbekistan, the man **in** the black coat, the bus **to** the airport. Yagona narsa ham — **the**.

sentences.text: Tashkent became **the capital of Uzbekistan** in 1930.
Who's **the man in the black coat**?
Do you know **the name of this street**? My map isn't working.
**The end of the film** was very sad.
Look at **the girl with the red umbrella** — that's my sister!
sentences.translation: **Qizil soyabonli qizga** qara — u mening singlim!

sentences.text: Dilnoza lives on **the fifth floor of a new building**.
**The price of petrol** went up again last week.
I've forgotten **the password for my email**.
**The people in this village** are very welcoming to guests.
sentences.translation: **Bu qishloqdagi odamlar** mehmonlarni juda yaxshi kutib oladi.

sentences.text: Is this **the bus to the airport**, or do I need **a different bus**?
sentences.translation: Bu **aeroportga boradigan avtobus**mi yoki menga **boshqa avtobus** kerakmi?

examples.title: Where's **the** ...? — Is there **a** ...?
examples.description: Savol va javob: ma'lum narsa haqida — **Where's the** ...?; bor-yo'qligini so'rash — **Is there a** ...? Javobda tilga olingan narsa endi **the** bilan.

sentences.text: Where's **the toilet**, please? — Down the corridor on the right.
Is there **a supermarket** near your flat? — Yes, just round the corner.
Have you got **a bike**? — Yes, but **the tyres** are flat.
Where are **the children**? — They're in **the park** with Grandpa.
Did you enjoy **the concert**? — Yes, it was fantastic!
Is there **a chemist's** open now? — Try **the chemist's** next to the station.
sentences.translation: Hozir ochiq **dorixona** bormi? — Vokzal yonidagi **dorixonaga** qarang.

sentences.text: How was **the exam**? — Not bad, but **the last question** was difficult.
sentences.translation: **Imtihon** qanday o'tdi? — Yomon emas, lekin **oxirgi savol** qiyin edi.

sentences.text: Who's **the woman** talking to your father? — She's **a neighbour**.
Do you know **a good dentist**? — Yes, go to **the dental clinic** on Amir Temur Street.
sentences.translation: **Yaxshi tish shifokorini** bilasizmi? — Ha, Amir Temur ko'chasidagi **stomatologiya klinikasiga** boring.

sentences.text: Where did you put **the keys**? — They're on **the shelf** by **the door**.

examples.title: **the** with plurals and uncountables
examples.description: **the** ko'plik va sanalmaydigan ot bilan ham: **the** salt, **the** flowers, **the** money. Noaniq bo'lsa — artiklsiz yoki **some**: some apples → **the** apples.

sentences.text: Can you pass **the salt**, please?
**The flowers** in your garden are beautiful!
I need **some sugar** for my tea — where's **the sugar**?
**The water** in the lake is very cold, even in July.
sentences.translation: Ko'ldagi **suv** hatto iyulda ham juda sovuq.

sentences.text: We bought **some apples**, but **the apples** weren't very sweet.
sentences.translation: Biz **olma** oldik, lekin **olmalar** unchalik shirin emas ekan.

sentences.text: Thank you for **the presents** — the children love them!
**The students** in my group come from six different countries.
Did you spend all **the money** on clothes?
**Music** helps me relax, but **the music** in that café is too loud.
sentences.translation: **Musiqa** menga dam olishga yordam beradi, lekin o'sha kafedagi **musiqa** juda baland.

sentences.text: Tom made **some coffee** for everybody, but **the coffee** was too strong for Sarah.
sentences.translation: Tom hammaga **qahva** damladi, lekin **qahva** Sara uchun juda achchiq edi.

examples.title: Dialogue: a lost bag at the station
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: yangi narsa — **a** (a bag, a camera), tanish yoki vaziyatdan aniq narsa — **the** (the train, the bag, the desk).

sentences.text: — Excuse me, I've lost **a bag**. I think I left it on **the train**.
sentences.translation: — Kechirasiz, **sumkamni** yo'qotib qo'ydim. Menimcha, uni **poyezdda** qoldirdim.

sentences.text: — Which train? **The train** from Samarkand?
— Yes, **the fast train**. It arrived at about ten o'clock.
sentences.translation: — Ha, **tezyurar poyezd**. Taxminan soat o'nda keldi.

sentences.text: — What does **the bag** look like?
— It's **a small black bag** with **a red scarf** on **the handle**.
— And what's inside **the bag**? Anything valuable?
sentences.translation: — **Sumka** ichida nima bor? Qimmatbaho narsa bormi?

sentences.text: — **A camera**, **a book** and **a present** for my grandmother.
— Wait a moment... Is this **the bag**? Somebody found it this morning.
sentences.translation: — Bir daqiqa... Shu **sumka**mi? Bugun ertalab kimdir topib olibdi.

sentences.text: — Yes, that's it! And **the camera** is still inside!
— Good. Please sign **the form** at **the desk** over there.
